findings.text: The head line cites d6665d49d3 with 5 passed, but the only head-arm log on disk ran at f0c753b2d7 and the manifest claims a second head run at c0e92cd96b, so the figure names a revision no reader can open against a receipt.

Both guard probes quote base and head output with no script and no log path, and the manifest names no probe log, so the query-side probe cannot be re-run; I reproduced the hook side from reckon/hooks/coordinator_obligations.py:260,822, where _row_is_actionable reads the set, but the query-side output has no receipt at all.

The added local import aliases reckon.flight as flight_module while query.py:845 already aliases the distinct module reckon.crew.flight under the same alias, so one file names two modules flight_module.

The done_when asks the named file green as a job on all_debug with SLURM_JOB_ID unset, and every arm instead ran in the worker's own worktree with env -u, so that one unmet condition is recorded nowhere in the manifest.

item_verdicts.diff: Read against base 24bc79d8ee: d6665d49d3 changes select_local=False, FlightConfigError and route-defaulted; c0e92cd96b and f0c753b2d7 are the evidence fragment, and the range's four other commits belong to other runs.
item_verdicts.done_when: It asks the file green as an all_debug job with SLURM_JOB_ID unset, a per-cause verdict, no assertion deleted, an importer arm adding no failure and a base control; all are recorded but the all_debug job, the four ids are at fragment line 19 and the importer arm moves 23 failed to 19.
item_verdicts.goal: The goal is that tests/test_queued_work_shows_where_held_work_shows.py passes in full; head-arm-target-file.log records 5 passed EXIT=0 at f0c753b2d7, and both repairs are in the diff at reckon/crew/query.py:796 and reckon/hooks/coordinator_obligations.py:260.
item_verdicts.manifest: Read; both suite arms read 58 passed EXIT=0 at 24bc79d8ee and f0c753b2d7, the base target arm 4 failed 1 passed, the head arm 5 passed, and the test file is stated unchanged.
item_verdicts.write_paths: The brief declares reckon, tests and the queued-work-needs-no-workaround fragment; the three commits touch reckon/crew/query.py, reckon/hooks/coordinator_obligations.py and that fragment, and no tests/ path is in the diff.

justifications.durability: tests/test_queued_work_shows_where_held_work_shows.py:246-249 compares two independent sets and the base arm reddens it, though a widened except clause at reckon/crew/query.py:797 would still pass.
justifications.evidence: baseline-suite.log and after-suite.log both reach a 58 passed summary with EXIT=0 at their own revisions, but the all_debug job was never opened and the fragment cites d6665d49d3, which no log on disk ran.
justifications.fit: the added lines follow query.py's function-local import style and the hook's prose-plus-frozenset idiom, but reckon/crew/query.py:791 reuses the alias flight_module for another module than query.py:845.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/query.py:796 stops the live view selecting this host's local lane and reckon/hooks/coordinator_obligations.py:260 stops route-defaulted holding a stop, so the five cases pass at f0c753b2d7.
justifications.reuse: the read reuses reckon/crew/admission/launching.py:127's own select_local parameter, already called that way at reckon/crew/admission/ordering.py:54, and the hook extends the copy the test holds to the derivation.
justifications.scope_discipline: reckon/crew/query.py, reckon/hooks/coordinator_obligations.py and the one evidence fragment are the whole of the three commits, all inside the declared write paths.
